subject: Phased commit schedule + split invoicing / tax reserve proposal
body:
From: Timothy Hayes <timothy.hayes@acme.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Phased commit schedule + split invoicing / tax reserve proposal

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo last week — product looked strong. Before we move forward with the Order Form, procurement asked whether we can phase the annual commit into tranches and have split invoicing to match our own internal budget quarters.

Specific asks from our side:
- Can the $600k annual commit be split into three tranches (Q3/Q4/Q1) with separate invoices?
- We need clarity on who is liable for VAT and whether Redwood can provide tax evidence (W9 / VAT certificate).
- Procurement prefers a small temporary tax reserve (a % held until registration confirmed) — can you confirm if you do holdbacks and what percent is standard?
- Net terms: our standard is Net45. Any objections?

Can you share a proposal so finance/legal can review?

Regards,
Tim
Timothy Hayes
Head of Procurement, ACME Corp

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Timothy Hayes <timothy.hayes@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased commit schedule + split invoicing / tax reserve proposal

Hi Timothy — thanks for the clear list. I can absolutely put together a proposal. Before I send to legal/finance for sign-off, one quick clarifying question: are the tranches equal ($200k each) or do you want front-loaded/uneven amounts?

I'll loop in Ben (finance) and Marissa (legal) to validate the tax reserve approach and whether Net45 is feasible under our standard order form. Expect a consolidated proposal by end of day Friday.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Phased commit schedule + split invoicing / tax reserve proposal

Team — forwarding ACME's email. Key points:
- $600k annual commit, they'd like 3 tranches (Q3/Q4/Q1).
- They expect invoices per tranche and want a small tax reserve until VAT registration evidence is provided.
- They prefer Net45.

Questions for finance/legal:
1) Is Redwood OK issuing 3 invoices tied to the same order form (one OF, multiple invoices)? Any impact on revenue recognition / min-commit?
2) What % reserve do we typically propose for international VAT uncertainty (they're US-headquartered but operate in EU)?
3) Do we need to amend the MSA or Order Form to explicitly allow split invoicing and holdback?

Attaching ACME's note. Happy to run a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jasmine

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Phased commit schedule + split invoicing / tax reserve proposal

Jasmine / team — quick read and proposed approach from finance:

Proposed commercial/finance handling:
- Commit phasing: Acceptable to split the $600k into three invoices: $200k each. We will treat the full OF commitment as one contract for ARR/recognition, but issue three distinct invoices tied to milestone dates.
- Invoice cadence: Invoice 1 on execution, Invoice 2 on 2027-10-01, Invoice 3 on 2028-01-01 (dates aligned to ACME quarters).
- Net terms: Net45 is acceptable. We'll note this in the OF payment terms.
- Tax reserve: Recommend a 5% temporary reserve on each invoice for VAT/withholding uncertainty in non-US jurisdictions. Reserve refundable upon receipt of tax registration evidence (VAT registration certificate / tax residency docs).
- PO visibility: We can include a 'Customer PO' field on invoices as requested.

Legal / MSA considerations (Marissa):
- We should add an invoice-splitting clause in the Order Form: "Customer may request phased billing; Redwood will issue invoices as specified in the Order Form. All invoices are subject to the Payment Terms set forth in the MSA."
- For the tax reserve, propose adding a one-line clause: "Redwood may withhold up to X% of invoiced amounts as a tax reserve pending customer submission of tax evidence; withheld amounts will be released upon receipt of satisfactory documentation." Marissa — can you draft the exact language?

Attachments (for customer): proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx (stub), redwood-tax-evidence.pdf (stub: Redwood W-9 + EU VAT discussion).

Ben Carter
Finance, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Timothy Hayes <timothy.hayes@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: phased commit + split invoices + temporary tax reserve (ACME)

Hi Timothy — following up with a consolidated proposal from Redwood based on internal review. Summary below and attached files: proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx, redwood-tax-evidence.pdf.

Proposal summary:
- Total commitment: $600,000 for 12 months (Order Form OF-ACME-7890).
- Phased invoices: three invoices of $200,000 each.
  - Invoice 1: upon Order Form execution (due Net45)
  - Invoice 2: 2027-10-01 (due Net45)
  - Invoice 3: 2028-01-01 (due Net45)
- Tax reserve: Redwood requests a temporary 5% holdback on each invoice (i.e., Redwood invoices 95% and reserves 5% in our payable ledger) until ACME provides VAT registration or tax residency evidence for the billing jurisdictions. Reserve will be refunded within 10 business days of evidence receipt.
- Invoicing details: Redwood can include the Customer PO on each invoice and add a reference to the Order Form number.
- Contract language: We will add two short clauses to the Order Form to permit phased billing and the temporary tax reserve; no changes to core MSA liability clauses.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm tranche amounts (we assumed equal 200k each).
2) Confirm acceptance of 5% temporary reserve or propose a lower %.
3) Provide PO number to be printed on invoices and any specific billing contact.

If this looks good, we'll prepare an amended Order Form PDF and a DocuSign link for signature (I'll include the invoice schedule as an appendix).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), redwood-tax-evidence.pdf (stub: Redwood W-9 and guidance)

From: Timothy Hayes <timothy.hayes@acme.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: phased commit + split invoices + temporary tax reserve (ACME)

Jasmine — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear proposal. A few notes from our side after procurement/legal review:
- Tranches: equal $200k each is fine.
- Tax reserve: we'd prefer a 3% holdback rather than 5%, given our ability to provide VAT evidence within two weeks after first invoice. Can Redwood accept 3%?
- PO: attaching our PO (ACME_PO_7890.pdf) — please show PO# 7890 on all invoices.
- VAT reverse charge: Can Redwood confirm whether we should expect reverse-charge on EU invoices (we operate sales entities in DE/FR). If reverse-charge applies, we won't need the reserve once we confirm the reverse-charge applicability.

If Redwood can accept 3%, we'll sign the order when you send the DocuSign link.

Regards,
Timothy

Attachment: ACME_PO_7890.pdf
